cloudflare.scope: Existing nine Baltor product hosts. AgentFeeds uses Cloudflare DNS only and serves directly from Fly. Public file count excludes the extra control-index asset.

agentfeeds_dns.authority: The owner explicitly authorized DNS management and Cloudflare nameservers in this conversation.
agentfeeds_dns.publication_observation: Registrar acknowledgment and registry RDAP preceded .si parent publication; parent was observed on Cloudflare at 19:05 UTC. Recursive caches converged later. Ordinary HTTPS at both origins was verified before the full browser run.

edge_readback.scope: Exact bodies, required headers and export identity in one complete pass.

agentfeeds_live.scope: Ordinary public DNS and verified TLS; source-pinned public bytes, health and same-origin metadata, other-product and wrong-origin refusals, two independent anonymous profiles per origin, desktop/phone browser downloads and edit invalidation.

retained_failed_attempts: The initial 4505-test tools population retained six failures, three errors and three skips. Missing ELK dependencies were installed and the owning 20 tests passed; five fresh-harness failures reproduced the environment's hidden default /tmp and all ten owning checks passed with task-owned temporary storage. One real documentation-route checker defect was fixed; 36 owning checks and a known-wrong control passed. The original full report remains failed, not relabeled as a complete passing rerun.

The first committed pristine export found the stale generated architecture index. Commit 67875526 regenerated it; exact final CI passed and its pristine export is identical. A mistyped targeted test name is retained separately.

The first private deploy preflight stopped before intent, gate or dispatch because Fly exec omits exit_code on success. Real zero/nonzero probes and 17 operator checks qualified the response handling. Only one actual guarded deployment was dispatched.
Private Cloudflare operator import/result-shape mismatches were reconciled against installed MCP 2.2 before mutations; the live read-only probe passed and one edge release was executed.
Live offering attempt 01 passed 104 checks before its completed-matrix assertion failed on a /library navigation timeout. A complete unchanged second run passed 497/497 with no browser errors.
Initial live pulse passed 49/50 and retained one transport failure on examples.baltor.ai health. An immediate direct read was ready; the full second pulse passed 50/50 with no slow reads.

Before delegation/cache convergence, public DNS still reached Namecheap parking. Direct Fly socket-target checks retained real SNI/TLS/Host verification but were not treated as public-domain launch proof. The final 414-check run used ordinary public DNS without address overrides.
limits: Live tests use anonymous contexts and emulated viewports. Authenticated account, email, recovery, consent and payment behavior has local/fixture coverage but was not re-executed with real customer identities or charges on AgentFeeds.
Curated source references and local reading profiles are live. Hosted saved feeds, personalized maintained decision streams, activated schedules and measured customer outcomes remain separate work.
No model generation, token-savings benchmark, adaptive customer queue or hosted overnight execution is established by this release.
No catalogue, R2, billing or subscription mutation occurred. AgentFoundry and AgentAFK standalone sites remain unfinished.
